name: Perenual Plant API
tagline: Plant species, care, and hardiness data for gardening apps
description: REST API for plant species lists and details, care guides, hardiness maps, and searchable pest/disease listings. It exposes botanical data including growth, images, watering, and sunlight. A free Personal plan is available. The disease endpoint lists records; plant identification is a separate beta API.

auth.details: API key via key query parameter (self-serve signup at perenual.com). Example: ?key=YOUR_API_KEY

pricing.free_tier_limits: Personal plan: 100 requests/day; Regular API; species data IDs 1-3000; hardiness maps and plant care guides/FAQ for species IDs 1-3000; plant disease API IDs 1-100.

rate_limits: Daily request quotas: Personal 100; Premium 10,000; Supreme 100,000; Enterprise custom limits.
use_cases: list plant species with filters for watering and sunlight
get detailed care guide for a plant species by ID
look up hardiness zone suitability for a plant
search plants by common or scientific name
